name: Cat God
source: A benevolent Cat God that rules over the Cat Kingdom. As a reward for [url=https://vndb.org/c49076]Ibuki[/url]'s good deeds towards cats, the Cat God gifts Ibuki a catgirl that Ibuki has wanted for so long.
translation: A benevolent Cat God that rules over the Cat Kingdom. As a reward for [url=https://vndb.org/c49076]Ibuki[/url]'s good deeds towards cats, the Cat God gifts Ibuki a catgirl that Ibuki has wanted for so long.
